objective: Test whether distinctions at several along-counts yield a smaller bond across base 16. Seek an arbitrary-support lower bound or an exact shorter bond; if neither is obtained, isolate and check the strongest new bound or construction with its own scope.
status: Proved the exact downward bond relation for every n >= 3 and along-count k >= 2; only two complementary assignments are excluded. The sharp lower bound for all supports is partial.
title: The across-count bound for unrestricted bonds
